description: This file defines a PHP class EmpUsTaxExemptionService within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the PIM plugin's Service namespace. It provides a service layer interface to access the EmpUsTaxExemptionDao data access object, encapsulating possible logic for handling US tax exemption data for employees.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionService
classes.description: Service class providing access to US tax exemption data via a DAO, with lazy initialization.

methods.name: getEmpUsTaxExemptionDao
methods.description: Returns the EmpUsTaxExemptionDao instance, creating it if it does not exist.
